title: Local CI environment reproduction and debugging
user_segment: Engineers maintaining CI and infrastructure scripts
problem: Repeated pushes to test CI scripts when the CI environment is difficult to reproduce locally.
statement: A developer asks for a CI environment that can be reproduced and debugged locally, describes repeated commits as painful and says they would pay for a solution.
source_locator: comment by wojciii and replies (thread lines 48–53)
source_context_date: 2026-01 (approximate; discussion marked 10 months old as of 2026-11-03)
limitations: A single claimed willingness to pay is not proven conversion.
Existing container-based CI tooling may already address parts of the problem.
Need independent user interviews or corroborating published observations before claiming general demand.
questions: How closely can local execution mirror hosted CI?
Which workflows cannot easily be reproduced?
